title: Fix file attachments without a name throwing in development builds
body:
> A bot file attachment without `name` throws "Validation error while parsing props" in development builds, and production builds label its link "Download file 'false'".

## Changelog Entry

### Fixed

- Fixed file attachments without `name` throwing in development or labeled "Download file 'false'", in PR [#6007](https://github.com/microsoft/BotFramework-WebChat/pull/6007), by [@OEvgeny](https://github.com/OEvgeny)

## Description

`FileAttachment` passed the optional `attachment.name` to `FileContent`, whose `fileName` prop is a required string. It now falls back to an empty name, so the attachment renders with a download icon and the link reads "Download file ''".

## Design

- The fallback sits where the activity is read, as in the screen reader renderer of file attachments; `FileContent` keeps `fileName` required.
- Not taken: the send box's "A file" label (the link would read "Download file 'A file'") or a name parsed from `contentUrl`; the empty `download` attribute already lets the browser name the saved file.
- A "Download file" label without the empty quotes needs new localized strings; left for a follow-up.

## Specific Changes

- `FileAttachment.js`: `fileName` falls back to `''`
- `attachment/file.noName.html` (+ `.fluent.html`): snapshot 1, a download icon without a file name; asserts the link name "Download file ''"

- [x] I have added tests and executed them locally
- [x] I have added `.changelog/<PR#>-<slug>.md`
- [ ] I have updated documentation
